description: Parents, not bureaucrats, have the fundamental right to direct the upbringing, health, and education of their children. This session, we passed several measures to put parents back in the driver's seat and protect children from agendas that have no place in our classrooms. HB 2082 protects parents who raise their children in a manner consistent with the child's biological sex.
